description: This file defines the CatalogPlugin interface, a marker interface for Spark catalog implementations, including methods for initialization, retrieving the catalog name, and default namespace.

classes.name: CatalogPlugin
classes.description: A marker interface for Spark catalog implementations, requiring initialization and configuration methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the catalog with a name and configuration options.

methods.name: defaultNamespace
methods.description: Provides a default namespace for the catalog, not required to exist.
